acceptanceCriteria.summary: The login screen displays Username, Password and Login controls.
The user can enter valid credentials.

acceptanceCriteria.gap: Mobile: the demo credential is accepted, but so is any other non-empty pair (D-M1).

acceptanceCriteria.summary: Invalid credentials display appropriate error messages.
acceptanceCriteria.gap: Mobile deviation D-M1: wrong credentials are accepted; only alice@example.com is rejected. Web matches.
Mobile wording differs: empty password shows 'Enter Password' (D-M5); both empty shows only the username error.

acceptanceCriteria.summary: Successful login navigates to the authenticated screen.
acceptanceCriteria.gap: Mobile: login returns to the Products screen that was already visible before login (D-M2).

acceptanceCriteria.summary: Users cannot access authenticated screens without successful login.
acceptanceCriteria.gap: Mobile deviation: app opens on Products without login. Web: forged session-username cookie grants access (D-W2).

acceptanceCriteria.summary: The user can log out, where supported.
acceptanceCriteria.gap: Mobile: no 'successfully logged out' message is shown.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify a registered user can log in with valid credentials.
preconditions: Browser is open on https://www.saucedemo.com/
User is not logged in
testCases.expectedResult: User lands on /inventory.html; the 'Products' title and 6 inventory items are displayed.
testCases.remarks: Manual run confirms the landing page visually; automation covers regression.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the login screen shows Username, Password and Login controls.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testCases.expectedResult: Username field (placeholder 'Username'), Password field (placeholder 'Password') and 'Login' button are visible and enabled.
testCases.remarks: Manual review judges layout and branding; automation asserts the controls are present.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the password is masked while typed.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testSteps: Type a password into the Password field
testCases.expectedResult: Characters are shown as dots; the field type is 'password'.
testCases.remarks: Manual check that dots are shown; automation asserts the field type. Password inputs have no ARIA role, so locator strategy needs agreement.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify pressing Enter in the Password field submits the form.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testCases.expectedResult: User lands on /inventory.html.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify submitting with both fields empty shows a validation error.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testCases.expectedResult: Error 'Epic sadface: Username is required' is shown; user stays on the login page.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify submitting a username without a password shows a validation error.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testCases.expectedResult: Error 'Epic sadface: Password is required' is shown; user stays on the login page.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify submitting a password without a username shows a validation error.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testCases.expectedResult: Error 'Epic sadface: Username is required' is shown; user stays on the login page.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify login fails for an unknown username.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testCases.expectedResult: Error 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service' is shown; no login.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify login fails for a valid username with a wrong password.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testCases.expectedResult: Error 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service' is shown; no login.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify login fails when both credentials are wrong.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testCases.expectedResult: Error 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service' is shown; no login.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the username is case sensitive.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testSteps: Enter the username in upper case
testCases.expectedResult: Login is rejected with the 'do not match any user' error.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the password is case sensitive.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testSteps: Enter the password in upper case
testCases.expectedResult: Login is rejected with the 'do not match any user' error.

testCases.testScenario: Leading and trailing spaces in username
testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify a username padded with spaces is not accepted.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testSteps: Enter the username with a leading and trailing space
testCases.expectedResult: Login is rejected with the 'do not match any user' error.
testCases.remarks: Manual run checks how the space is visible in the field; automation guards the rejection.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify a locked out user cannot log in.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testCases.expectedResult: Error 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.' is shown; no login.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the error banner can be dismissed with the close button.
preconditions: A validation error banner is displayed after a failed login
testSteps: Click the close (X) button on the banner
testCases.expectedResult: The error banner disappears.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the input fields and error banner are visually highlighted on error.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testSteps: Observe the fields and the banner
testCases.expectedResult: Fields show a red border and error icon; the banner is red with readable text.
testCases.remarks: Subjective visual check.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the authenticated screen shows the product list after login.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testCases.expectedResult: URL is /inventory.html, title is 'Products', and 6 products with 'Add to cart' buttons are displayed.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify a logged-in user can log out from the menu.
preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
testCases.expectedResult: User returns to https://www.saucedemo.com/ with empty Username and Password fields.
testCases.remarks: Manual run checks the menu animation; automation covers the logout regression. The menu slides in over about 0.5s.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the Back button after logout does not reveal authenticated content.
preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
testCases.expectedResult: Login page is shown with the error 'You can only access '/inventory.html' when you are logged in.'; no products are visible.

testCases.testScenario: Direct URL to inventory without login
testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the inventory page cannot be opened without logging in.
preconditions: No active session (cookies cleared)
testCases.expectedResult: Redirected to the login page with the error 'You can only access '/inventory.html' when you are logged in.'

testCases.testScenario: Direct URL to cart without login
testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the cart page cannot be opened without logging in.
preconditions: No active session (cookies cleared)
testCases.expectedResult: Redirected to the login page with the error 'You can only access '/cart.html' when you are logged in.'

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the user stays logged in after refreshing the inventory page.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testCases.expectedResult: User remains on /inventory.html with products displayed.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify logout removes the session cookie.
preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
testCases.expectedResult: Cookie 'session-username' is removed.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify SQL injection strings do not bypass authentication.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
Authorized test environment
testSteps: Enter the SQL payload in Username and Password
testCases.expectedResult: Login is rejected with the 'do not match any user' error; no application error or stack trace is shown.
testCases.remarks: A UI check cannot prove backend injection safety.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify script input is neither executed nor reflected as HTML.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
Authorized test environment
testSteps: Enter a script tag in Username
testCases.expectedResult: No dialog appears; the standard 'do not match any user' error is shown; the payload is not rendered in the page.
testCases.remarks: A UI check cannot prove all XSS vectors are closed.

testCases.testScenario: Credentials not exposed in URL or storage
testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the password is not placed in the URL, cookies or local storage.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testSteps: Inspect the URL, cookies and local storage
testCases.expectedResult: 'secret_sauce' does not appear in the URL, cookies or local storage.
testCases.remarks: Server logs and network traces are out of scope for this check.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify a manually created session cookie does not grant access without a successful login.
preconditions: No active session
Cookies can be set through dev tools or automation
testCases.expectedResult: Access is denied and the login page is shown.
testCases.actualResult: /inventory.html opened with 6 products using only the forged cookie.
testCases.remarks: Deviation D-W2, exploratory run 2026-10-12. Manual run documents the finding; automation tracks it until the app is fixed.

testCases.testScenario: Error does not reveal which field is wrong
testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the error text is identical for a wrong username and a wrong password.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testSteps: Log in with a wrong username and record the error
Log in with a wrong password and record the error
testCases.expectedResult: Both errors are exactly 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service'.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify very long username and password values are handled gracefully.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testSteps: Paste 1000 characters into Username and Password
testCases.expectedResult: Standard 'do not match any user' error; the page does not break or hang.
testCases.remarks: No maximum length is documented.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify special and unicode characters are handled gracefully.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testSteps: Enter special characters and unicode in Username
testCases.expectedResult: Standard 'do not match any user' error; no rendering issues.
testCases.remarks: Exploratory input check.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify accepted usernames and the shared password are not displayed on the login page.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testSteps: Scroll to the bottom of the page
testCases.expectedResult: No usernames or password are displayed.
testCases.actualResult: Accepted usernames and the password 'secret_sauce' are printed on the page.
testCases.remarks: Observation D-W1; by design for a demo site. Exploratory run 2026-10-12.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the form can be completed using the keyboard only.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testSteps: Press Tab to move to Username and type the username
Press Tab to Password and type the password
Press Tab to Login and press Enter
testCases.expectedResult: Focus order is Username, Password, Login; a focus indicator is visible; login succeeds.
testCases.remarks: Human judgment on the focus indicator.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the login page layout at desktop, tablet and mobile viewport sizes.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testSteps: Observe the form at each size
testCases.expectedResult: The form stays centered and usable with no overlap or horizontal scrolling.
testCases.remarks: Subjective visual check.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify login works in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
preconditions: Chromium, Firefox and WebKit are installed
testSteps: Run the valid login flow in each browser
testCases.expectedResult: Login succeeds and the inventory page is shown in all three browsers.
testCases.remarks: Manual run covers real browser builds; automation runs the Playwright browser projects.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify problem_user can log in.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testCases.expectedResult: User lands on /inventory.html.
testCases.remarks: Product images are expected to be wrong for this user; image behavior is outside login scope.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify performance_glitch_user can log in within an acceptable time.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testCases.expectedResult: The inventory page loads within 10 seconds.
testCases.remarks: The 10 second threshold is a test assumption, not a documented requirement.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify double-clicking Login does not cause duplicate navigation or errors.
preconditions: Browser is open on the login page
testCases.expectedResult: One login occurs; the inventory page displays normally.
testCases.remarks: Exploratory timing check.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify and document browser password-manager prompts that appear after login in a regular Chrome profile.
preconditions: Regular Chrome profile with Google Password Manager enabled
testCases.expectedResult: Login succeeds; a browser 'Change your password' breach warning may appear and does not come from the application.
testCases.remarks: Does not occur in Playwright's clean browser profile.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the login screen shows Username, Password and Login controls.
preconditions: App is installed and launched
testCases.expectedResult: Username field, Password field and 'Login' button are displayed.
testCases.remarks: Manual run judges layout; automation asserts the controls are displayed.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the Login screen is reachable from the navigation menu.
preconditions: App is launched
User is logged out
testCases.expectedResult: The Login screen with the 'Login' title is displayed; the menu shows 'Log In' while logged out.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify a user can log in with valid credentials.
preconditions: Login screen is displayed
testCases.expectedResult: The Products screen is displayed and the menu now shows 'Log Out'.
testCases.remarks: Manual run confirms the screen visually; automation covers regression.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the password is masked while typed.
preconditions: Login screen is displayed
testCases.expectedResult: Characters are masked; the Password field is of password type.
testCases.remarks: Manual check that characters are hidden; automation asserts the password attribute is true.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify tapping a listed username populates both fields.
preconditions: Login screen is displayed
testSteps: Tap the underlined 'bod@example.com' in the Usernames list
testCases.expectedResult: Username shows bod@example.com and Password is filled.
testCases.remarks: Behavior taken from app source; not run during exploration.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify submitting empty fields shows a validation message.
preconditions: Login screen is displayed
testCases.expectedResult: 'Username is required' is displayed; no password error is shown; the user stays on the Login screen.
testCases.remarks: Hidden error elements are absent from the page source; assert absence.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify a username without a password shows a validation message.
preconditions: Login screen is displayed
testCases.expectedResult: A password-required message is displayed. The app text is 'Enter Password'.
testCases.remarks: The AC wording suggests 'Password is required'; the app text differs (D-M5).

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify a password without a username shows a validation message.
preconditions: Login screen is displayed
testCases.expectedResult: 'Username is required' is displayed; the user stays on the Login screen.
testCases.remarks: Behavior taken from app source; not run during exploration.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify login is rejected for a valid username with a wrong password.
preconditions: Login screen is displayed
testCases.expectedResult: An error message is displayed and the user is not logged in.
testCases.actualResult: No error. The user was logged in and the Products screen opened.
testCases.remarks: Deviation D-M1, exploratory run 2026-10-12.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify login is rejected when both credentials are wrong.
preconditions: Login screen is displayed
testCases.expectedResult: An error message is displayed and the user is not logged in.
testCases.remarks: Expected to fail like TC_MOB_LOGIN_009 (D-M1); not run during exploration.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the locked-out user cannot log in.
preconditions: Login screen is displayed
testCases.expectedResult: 'Sorry this user has been locked out.' is displayed; the user stays on the Login screen.
testCases.remarks: Message confirmed in the exploratory run.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify a logged-in user can log out.
preconditions: User is logged in
testSteps: Tap LOGOUT in the confirmation dialog
testCases.expectedResult: The dialog 'Are you sure you want to logout' appears; after LOGOUT the Login screen is displayed with empty fields.
testCases.remarks: Manual run checks the dialog on screen; automation covers the logout regression. No logout success message is shown (source).

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify cancelling the logout dialog keeps the user logged in.
preconditions: User is logged in
testCases.expectedResult: The dialog closes; the user remains logged in and the menu still shows 'Log Out'.
testCases.remarks: Dialog buttons confirmed in the exploratory run; cancel path not run.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the menu offers 'Log In' again after logout.
preconditions: User is logged in
testCases.expectedResult: The menu shows 'Log In' and no 'Log Out'.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify authenticated content is not accessible before login.
preconditions: App is freshly launched
User has not logged in
testCases.expectedResult: The Login screen is shown, or authenticated content is blocked until login.
testCases.actualResult: The app opens directly on Products; the catalog and cart are usable without logging in.
testCases.remarks: Deviation to AC8, exploratory run 2026-10-12.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify starting checkout while logged out redirects to Login.
preconditions: User is logged out
At least one item is in the cart
testSteps: Add an item to the cart
testCases.expectedResult: The Login screen is displayed; after login the user continues to checkout info.
testCases.remarks: Behavior taken from app source; not run during exploration. Manual run confirms it first; automation added for regression.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the system Back button after logout does not return to an authenticated state.
preconditions: User is logged in
testCases.expectedResult: The app does not show a logged-in session; the menu still offers 'Log In'.
testCases.remarks: Not run during exploration. Manual run explores device Back behavior; automation guards the logged-out state.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify whitespace-only values are treated as empty.
preconditions: Login screen is displayed
testSteps: Enter spaces in Username and Password
testCases.expectedResult: 'Username is required' is displayed.
testCases.remarks: Based on app source (input is trimmed); not run.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify SQL injection strings do not bypass authentication.
preconditions: Login screen is displayed
Authorized test environment
testSteps: Enter the payload in Username and Password
testCases.expectedResult: Login is rejected with an error.
testCases.remarks: Expected to fail like D-M1; not run. Manual run explores the payload; automation guards the outcome. A UI check cannot prove backend safety.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify and document whether the login session persists after the app is force-stopped and reopened.
preconditions: User is logged in
testCases.expectedResult: Needs Clarification: no persistence behavior is specified. Record whether the menu shows 'Log In' or 'Log Out'.
testCases.remarks: App source suggests the session is not persisted; the requirement is undocumented.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify very long values do not crash the app.
preconditions: Login screen is displayed
testCases.expectedResult: No crash or freeze; the app responds as for any other credentials.
testCases.remarks: No maximum length is documented.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify entered values and layout survive rotation.
preconditions: Login screen is displayed
testSteps: Rotate the device to landscape and back
testCases.expectedResult: No crash; the fields and Login button remain usable. Note any lost input.
testCases.remarks: Device interaction judged by a person.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the soft keyboard does not hide the Login button and IME actions work.
preconditions: Login screen is displayed
testSteps: Scroll if needed to reach Login
testCases.expectedResult: The fields and Login button remain reachable; the keyboard can be dismissed.
testCases.remarks: Device and keyboard dependent.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the biometric login button is hidden when biometrics are not enabled.
preconditions: Biometric login is not enabled in the app
testCases.expectedResult: Only the 'Login' button is shown.
testCases.remarks: Behavior taken from app source.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify visual@example.com can log in.
preconditions: Login screen is displayed
testCases.expectedResult: The Products screen is displayed.
testCases.remarks: Visual-change user; outside core login automation.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify usernames and the password are not listed on the Login screen.
preconditions: Login screen is displayed
testCases.expectedResult: No credentials are displayed.
testCases.actualResult: Usernames and the password are listed on the screen (from app source and layout).
testCases.remarks: Observation D-M4; by design for a demo app.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the login controls expose accessibility descriptions for TalkBack.
preconditions: TalkBack is enabled
testSteps: Focus each control on the Login screen
testCases.expectedResult: Each control is announced with a meaningful name.
testCases.remarks: Human-judgment accessibility check.

testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify the password is not written to logcat during login.
preconditions: Device is connected with adb
testCases.expectedResult: The password value does not appear in logcat.
testCases.remarks: Needs adb access and manual log review.
